levels.surface: محمد بن الحسين بن أبي الخطاب

notes: Opens «وعنه، بإسناده»: prev1 writes its chain, so «عنه» takes over its first teacher (أبي, inherited). How much of prev1 «بإسناده» takes over is not certain, so it is written as back_reference as it stands
Two routes of one saying: the first ends at أبان with no matn of its own, the second («قال: وحدثني») carries the matn; both share the inherited head
«أبي جعفر» sits inside the chain after «عن»: narrator (owner ruling 2)
